en: Black-and-white view of a quiet residential street lined with ornate multi‑story townhouses in late 19th–early 20th century style. The buildings feature steep tiled roofs, bay windows, decorative gables, and small balconies with flower boxes. A gazebo-like structure stands behind a brick wall on the right. The street is cobblestoned and largely empty, with only a few distant pedestrians and a horse or cart. In the far distance a church spire is visible.
